## MechWarrior 1 Remake 1.1.3

Fixes, and the Remake sets itself up.

- **The menus stay 4:3 on a screen narrower than 16:9 with WIDE MENUS on** (issue #1): at 1680x1050 the hub ran past the right edge of the screen.
- **The Remake could crash as it closed.** Fixed.
- **The Remake finds and copies your MechWarrior (1989) itself,** on the launcher's screens as before. With launcher 1.6.0, update the Remake to this version (UPDATE ALL).

Saved games are unchanged: 1.1.3 reads and writes the same saves as 1.1.2.

You still need your own copies of MechWarrior (1989), MechWarrior 3 and Pirate's Moon.
